import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Shield } from 'lucide-react';
import { App as CapacitorApp } from '@capacitor/app';
import { SetupVaultView } from './components/SetupVaultView';
import { LockVaultView } from './components/LockVaultView';
import { MainVaultView } from './components/MainVaultView';
import { SettingsModal } from './components/SettingsModal';
import { ToastContainer, ToastData } from './components/Toast';
import { openVaultDatabase, clearVaultDatabase } from './db/vaultDb';
import { initScreenshotBlocker, setScreenshotBlockToastCallback } from './services/screenshotBlockService';
import { initBackButtonListener } from './services/backButtonService';
import { updateService, UpdateCheckResult } from './services/updateService';
import { UpdateNotificationBanner, UpdateNotificationModal } from './components/UpdateNotificationModal';
import { CURRENT_APP_VERSION } from './version';

export default function App() {
  const [vaultStatus, setVaultStatus] = useState<'checking' | 'setup' | 'locked' | 'unlocked'>('checking');
  const [masterKey, setMasterKey] = useState<CryptoKey | null>(null);
  const [sessionPin, setSessionPin] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastData[]>([]);
  const [isSettingsOpen, setIsSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPrivacyBlurActive, setIsPrivacyBlurActive] = useState(false);

  // Settings
  const [autoLockMinutes, setAutoLockMinutes] = useState<number>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('vault_autolock_mins');
    const val = Number(saved);
    return saved !== null && !isNaN(val) ? val : 5;
  });

  const [lockOnTabSwitch, setLockOnTabSwitch] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('vault_lock_on_tab_switch');
    return saved !== null ? saved === 'true' : true;
  });

  const [vaultRefreshTrigger, setVaultRefreshTrigger] = useState<number>(0);

  // Sistema de Actualizaciones
  const [pendingUpdateInfo, setPendingUpdateInfo] = useState<UpdateCheckResult | null>(null);
  const [showUpdateBanner, setShowUpdateBanner] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showUpdateModal, setShowUpdateModal] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const inactivityTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Toast Helper
  const showToast = useCallback((message: string, type: 'info' | 'success' | 'alert' | 'error' = 'info') => {
    const id = `${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}`;
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type }]);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    }, 3200);
  }, []);

  // Lock Vault Action
  const lockVault = useCallback(() => {
    // Strictly forbid locking while picking files or running backup operations
    if ((window as any).__isPickingFile || (window as any).__isProcessingBackup) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      sessionStorage.removeItem('vault_session_pin');
    } catch {}
    setMasterKey(null);
    setSessionPin(null);
    setVaultStatus('locked');
    setIsSettingsOpen(false);
  }, []);

  // Memoized unlock handler with extended post-unlock immunity grace period (20 seconds)
  const handleUnlock = useCallback((key: CryptoKey, pin?: string) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    (window as any).__lastUnlockTime = now;
    (window as any).__lastBiometricUnlockTime = now;
    setMasterKey(key);
    if (pin) {
      setSessionPin(pin);
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem('vault_session_pin', pin);
      } catch {}
    }
    setVaultStatus('unlocked');
  }, []);

  // Android Back navigation for settings
  const isSettingsOpenRef = useRef(isSettingsOpen);
  isSettingsOpenRef.current = isSettingsOpen;
  const wasSettingsOpenRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSettingsOpen && !wasSettingsOpenRef.current) {
      window.history.pushState({ appOverlay: 'settings' }, '');
      wasSettingsOpenRef.current = true;
    } else if (!isSettingsOpen && wasSettingsOpenRef.current) {
      wasSettingsOpenRef.current = false;
      if (window.history.state?.appOverlay === 'settings') {
        window.history.back();
      }
    }
  }, [isSettingsOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handlePopState = () => {
      if (isSettingsOpenRef.current) {
        wasSettingsOpenRef.current = false;
        setIsSettingsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePopState);
  }, []);

  // Check initial vault existence on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    const init = async () => {
      try {
        await openVaultDatabase();
        const isInit = localStorage.getItem('vault_initialized');
        const saltHex = localStorage.getItem('vault_salt');
        const testIvHex = localStorage.getItem('vault_test_iv');
        const testCipherHex = localStorage.getItem('vault_test_cipher');

        if (isInit === 'true' && saltHex && testIvHex && testCipherHex) {
          // Siempre requerir PIN o Huella al abrir o reabrir la aplicación
          setVaultStatus('locked');
        } else {
          setVaultStatus('setup');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Initialization error:', err);
        setVaultStatus('setup');
      }
    };

    init();
    initScreenshotBlocker();
    setScreenshotBlockToastCallback(showToast);
    initBackButtonListener();
  }, [showToast]);

  // Root back button press notice
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleRootBack = () => {
      showToast('Presiona o desliza atrás de nuevo para salir', 'info');
    };
    const handleRootExit = () => {
      showToast('Saliendo de la bóveda...', 'info');
    };
    window.addEventListener('vault_root_back_press', handleRootBack);
    window.addEventListener('vault_root_exit_allowed', handleRootExit);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('vault_root_back_press', handleRootBack);
      window.removeEventListener('vault_root_exit_allowed', handleRootExit);
    };
  }, [showToast]);

  // Detección automática de actualizaciones al entrar a la aplicación
  useEffect(() => {
    // Si la app acaba de actualizarse, mostrar saludo de confirmación
    if (sessionStorage.getItem('vault_just_updated') === 'true') {
      sessionStorage.removeItem('vault_just_updated');
      setTimeout(() => {
        showToast(`¡Bóveda actualizada con éxito a la versión v${CURRENT_APP_VERSION}!`, 'success');
      }, 700);
    }

    if (!updateService.isAutoCheckEnabled()) return;

    // Comprobar actualizaciones tras 1.5s para no competir con el arranque inicial
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await updateService.checkForUpdates();
        if (res.hasUpdate) {
          setPendingUpdateInfo(res);
          if (!updateService.isUpdateDismissed(res.latestVersion)) {
            setShowUpdateBanner(true);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Error al verificar actualizaciones al entrar:', e);
      }
    }, 1500);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [showToast]);

  // Suscribirse a eventos de actualización
  useEffect(() => {
    return updateService.subscribe((res) => {
      if (res.hasUpdate) {
        setPendingUpdateInfo(res);
        if (!updateService.isUpdateDismissed(res.latestVersion)) {
          setShowUpdateBanner(true);
        }
      }
    });
  }, []);

  // App privacy blur shield and immediate locking when minimizing or switching apps
  useEffect(() => {
    let appStateHandle: any = null;

    const isUserPickingFiles = () => {
      if ((window as any).__isPickingFile) return true;
      const startTime = (window as any).__filePickingStartTime || 0;
      if (startTime > 0 && Date.now() - startTime < 180000) return true; // 3 min grace window while picking files
      return false;
    };

    const handleMinimizeOrBackground = () => {
      if (isUserPickingFiles() || (window as any).__isProcessingBackup) {
        return;
      }
      lockVault();
    };

    if (CapacitorApp && typeof CapacitorApp.addListener === 'function') {
      try {
        CapacitorApp.addListener('appStateChange', (state) => {
          if (!isUserPickingFiles()) {
            setIsPrivacyBlurActive(!state.isActive);
          }
          if (!state.isActive) {
            handleMinimizeOrBackground();
          } else {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vault_app_resumed'));
          }
        }).then((h) => {
          appStateHandle = h;
        }).catch(() => {});
      } catch {}
    }

    const handleDocVisibility = () => {
      const isHidden = document.visibilityState === 'hidden';
      if (!isUserPickingFiles()) {
        setIsPrivacyBlurActive(isHidden);
      }
      if (isHidden) {
        handleMinimizeOrBackground();
      } else {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vault_app_resumed'));
      }
    };

    const handleWindowBlur = () => {
      if (!isUserPickingFiles()) {
        setIsPrivacyBlurActive(true);
      }
      handleMinimizeOrBackground();
    };

    const handleWindowFocus = () => {
      setIsPrivacyBlurActive(false);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vault_app_resumed'));
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleDocVisibility);
    window.addEventListener('blur', handleWindowBlur);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleWindowFocus);

    return () => {
      if (appStateHandle && typeof appStateHandle.remove === 'function') {
        appStateHandle.remove();
      }
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleDocVisibility);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', handleWindowBlur);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleWindowFocus);
    };
  }, [lockVault]);

  // Inactivity auto-lock
  useEffect(() => {
    const mins = Number(autoLockMinutes);
    if (vaultStatus !== 'unlocked' || isNaN(mins) || mins <= 0) {
      if (inactivityTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
        inactivityTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    const resetTimer = () => {
      if (inactivityTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
      }
      if ((window as any).__isProcessingBackup || (window as any).__isPickingFile) {
        // Pause auto-lock completely during backup generation/restoration or file picking
        return;
      }
      inactivityTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        lockVault();
      }, mins * 60 * 1000);
    };

    resetTimer();

    const activityEvents = ['mousedown', 'mousemove', 'keydown', 'scroll', 'touchstart', 'pointerdown', 'click'];
    activityEvents.forEach((evt) => window.addEventListener(evt, resetTimer, { passive: true }));

    return () => {
      if (inactivityTimerRef.current) {
        window.clearTimeout(inactivityTimerRef.current);
        inactivityTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      activityEvents.forEach((evt) => window.removeEventListener(evt, resetTimer));
    };
  }, [vaultStatus, autoLockMinutes, lockVault]);

  // Robust File Picker protection: keeps auto-lock completely paused while Android File Picker is active
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleFilePickerClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (!target) return;

      const isFileInput = target.tagName === 'INPUT' && (target as HTMLInputElement).type === 'file';
      const isLabelForFile = target.closest('label') && target.closest('label')?.querySelector('input[type="file"]');

      if (isFileInput || isLabelForFile) {
        (window as any).__isPickingFile = true;
        (window as any).__filePickingStartTime = Date.now();
      }
    };

    // When the user finishes picking or cancels, reset the flag safely with a 4s grace window
    const handleFileChangeOrCancel = (e: Event) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (target && target.tagName === 'INPUT' && (target as HTMLInputElement).type === 'file') {
        setTimeout(() => {
          (window as any).__isPickingFile = false;
        }, 4000);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('click', handleFilePickerClick, true);
    window.addEventListener('change', handleFileChangeOrCancel, true);
    window.addEventListener('cancel', handleFileChangeOrCancel, true);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('click', handleFilePickerClick, true);
      window.removeEventListener('change', handleFileChangeOrCancel, true);
      window.removeEventListener('cancel', handleFileChangeOrCancel, true);
    };
  }, []);

  // Lock on tab visibility change, minimize or pagehide
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!lockOnTabSwitch) return;

    const isUserPickingFiles = () => {
      if ((window as any).__isPickingFile) return true;
      const startTime = (window as any).__filePickingStartTime || 0;
      if (startTime > 0 && Date.now() - startTime < 180000) return true;
      return false;
    };

    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      // Ignore if user is actively picking files or processing backup
      if (isUserPickingFiles() || (window as any).__isProcessingBackup) {
        return;
      }

      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden' && vaultStatus === 'unlocked') {
        // Bloquear inmediatamente al minimizar o pasar a segundo plano
        lockVault();
      }
    };

    const handlePageHide = () => {
      if (isUserPickingFiles() || (window as any).__isProcessingBackup) {
        return;
      }
      if (vaultStatus === 'unlocked') {
        lockVault();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', handlePageHide);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', handlePageHide);
    };
  }, [lockOnTabSwitch, vaultStatus, lockVault]);

  // Panic key: Escape locks immediately
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && vaultStatus === 'unlocked' && !isSettingsOpen) {
        lockVault();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [vaultStatus, isSettingsOpen, lockVault]);

  // Reset Vault Handler
  const handleResetVault = async () => {
    try {
      await clearVaultDatabase();
      try {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('vault_session_pin');
      } catch {}
      localStorage.removeItem('vault_salt');
      localStorage.removeItem('vault_test_iv');
      localStorage.removeItem('vault_test_cipher');
      localStorage.removeItem('vault_initialized');
      localStorage.removeItem('vault_pin_length');

      setMasterKey(null);
      setIsSettingsOpen(false);
      setVaultStatus('setup');
      showToast('Bóveda restablecida por completo', 'alert');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error resetting vault:', err);
      showToast('Error al restablecer la bóveda', 'error');
    }
  };

  // Preference change listeners
  const handleAutoLockChange = (mins: number) => {
    setAutoLockMinutes(mins);
    localStorage.setItem('vault_autolock_mins', mins.toString());
  };

  const handleLockOnTabSwitchChange = (enabled: boolean) => {
    setLockOnTabSwitch(enabled);
    localStorage.setItem('vault_lock_on_tab_switch', enabled ? 'true' : 'false');
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#090d16] text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans select-none w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden">
      {/* Toast Notification Layer */}
      <ToastContainer toasts={toasts} />

      {/* Screen Routing */}
      {vaultStatus === 'checking' && (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent animate-spin" />
        </div>
      )}

      {vaultStatus === 'setup' && (
        <SetupVaultView
          onSetupComplete={(key, pin) => handleUnlock(key, pin)}
          showToast={showToast}
        />
      )}

      {vaultStatus === 'locked' && (
        <LockVaultView
          onUnlock={handleUnlock}
          onResetVaultRequest={handleResetVault}
          showToast={showToast}
        />
      )}

      {vaultStatus === 'unlocked' && masterKey && (
        <>
          <MainVaultView
            masterKey={masterKey}
            sessionPin={sessionPin}
            onLock={lockVault}
            onOpenSettings={() => setIsSettingsOpen(true)}
            showToast={showToast}
            refreshTrigger={vaultRefreshTrigger}
            autoLockMinutes={autoLockMinutes}
            onAutoLockChange={handleAutoLockChange}
            lockOnTabSwitch={lockOnTabSwitch}
            onLockOnTabSwitchChange={handleLockOnTabSwitchChange}
            onMasterKeyUpdated={(newKey) => {
              setMasterKey(newKey);
              setVaultRefreshTrigger((prev) => prev + 1);
            }}
            onResetVault={handleResetVault}
            hasUpdatePending={!!pendingUpdateInfo?.hasUpdate}
          />

          <SettingsModal
            isOpen={isSettingsOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsSettingsOpen(false)}
            masterKey={masterKey}
            sessionPin={sessionPin}
            onMasterKeyUpdated={(newKey) => {
              setMasterKey(newKey);
              setVaultRefreshTrigger((prev) => prev + 1);
            }}
            autoLockMinutes={autoLockMinutes}
            onAutoLockChange={handleAutoLockChange}
            lockOnTabSwitch={lockOnTabSwitch}
            onLockOnTabSwitchChange={handleLockOnTabSwitchChange}
            onPhotosUpdated={() => {
              setVaultRefreshTrigger((prev) => prev + 1);
            }}
            onResetVault={handleResetVault}
            showToast={showToast}
          />
        </>
      )}

      {/* Aviso flotante de Actualización Disponible al entrar */}
      {showUpdateBanner && pendingUpdateInfo && (
        <UpdateNotificationBanner
          updateInfo={pendingUpdateInfo}
          onOpenDetails={() => {
            setShowUpdateBanner(false);
            setShowUpdateModal(true);
          }}
          onApplyUpdate={() => updateService.applyUpdate()}
          onDismiss={() => {
            setShowUpdateBanner(false);
            if (pendingUpdateInfo.latestVersion) {
              updateService.dismissUpdate(pendingUpdateInfo.latestVersion);
            }
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Modal interactivo con Novedades de la Versión */}
      <UpdateNotificationModal
        isOpen={showUpdateModal}
        onClose={() => setShowUpdateModal(false)}
        updateInfo={pendingUpdateInfo}
        viewNotesOnly={false}
      />

      {/* Privacy Blur Shield when minimizing app or switching tasks */}
      {isPrivacyBlurActive && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] backdrop-blur-3xl bg-[#060b14]/90 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center select-none animate-in fade-in duration-100 pointer-events-none">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-3xl bg-[#00e5ff]/10 border border-[#00e5ff]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[#00e5ff] mb-4 shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,229,255,0.25)] animate-pulse">
            <Shield className="w-10 h-10 stroke-[2]" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight mb-1">
            Mi Bóveda Protegida
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium">
            Contenido privado oculto por seguridad
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
// Importamos iconos limpios y estilizados de trazo fino (estilo Outline)
import { Heart, Copy, Download, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface BarraAccionesProps {
  esFavorito: boolean;
  onAlternarFavorito: () => void;
  onCopiar: () => void;
  onSacarDeBoveda: () => void;
  onEliminar: () => void;
  mostrarCopiar?: boolean;
  estaSacando?: boolean;
  esInmersivo?: boolean;
}

export const BarraAccionesInferior: React.FC<BarraAccionesProps> = ({
  esFavorito,
  onAlternarFavorito,
  onCopiar,
  onSacarDeBoveda,
  onEliminar,
  mostrarCopiar = true,
  estaSacando = false,
  esInmersivo = false,
}) => {
  return (
    <footer
      className={`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 w-full bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-4 pb-safe flex items-center justify-around border-t border-white/5 transition-transform duration-300 ${
        esInmersivo ? 'translate-y-full opacity-0 pointer-events-none' : 'translate-y-0 opacity-100'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Botón Favorito: cambia de estilo si está activo */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onAlternarFavorito}
        className="p-3 text-white transition-colors duration-200 active:scale-95 hover:text-red-400 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
        aria-label="Favorito"
        title={esFavorito ? 'Quitar de favoritos' : 'Añadir a favoritos'}
      >
        <Heart 
          size={24} 
          strokeWidth={1.5} 
          className={esFavorito ? 'fill-red-500 text-red-500' : ''}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Botón Copiar al portapapeles */}
      {mostrarCopiar && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCopiar}
          className="p-3 text-white transition-colors duration-200 active:scale-95 hover:text-blue-400 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
          aria-label="Copiar"
          title="Copiar imagen al portapapeles"
        >
          <Copy size={24} strokeWidth={1.5} />
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Botón Sacar de la Bóveda (Descargar/Exportar al almacenamiento libre) */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onSacarDeBoveda}
        disabled={estaSacando}
        className="p-3 text-white transition-colors duration-200 active:scale-95 hover:text-green-400 focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
        aria-label="Sacar de Bóveda"
        title="Sacar de la bóveda a tu galería libre"
      >
        <Download 
          size={24} 
          strokeWidth={1.5} 
          className={estaSacando ? 'animate-bounce text-green-400' : ''}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Botón Eliminar permanentemente */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onEliminar}
        className="p-3 text-white transition-colors duration-200 active:scale-95 hover:text-red-500 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
        aria-label="Eliminar"
        title="Eliminar permanentemente"
      >
        <Trash2 size={24} strokeWidth={1.5} />
      </button>
    </footer>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core';
import {
  RefreshCw,
  Download,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileText,
  Check,
  ExternalLink,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getSafeAppVersionCode, downloadAndInstallApk } from '../services/nativeUpdaterBridge';
import { updateService } from '../services/updateService';
import { CURRENT_APP_VERSION, CURRENT_BUILD_NUMBER, CURRENT_RELEASE_DATE } from '../version';

interface VersionResponseData {
  version_code?: number;
  buildNumber?: number;
  version_name?: string;
  version?: string;
  download_url?: string;
  changelog?: string[];
  releaseDate?: string;
}

interface BovedaUpdaterProps {
  onOpenChangelog?: () => void;
}

export const BovedaUpdater: React.FC<BovedaUpdaterProps> = ({ onOpenChangelog }) => {
  const [updateAvailable, setUpdateAvailable] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [downloadUrl, setDownloadUrl] = useState<string>('');
  const [serverVersionName, setServerVersionName] = useState<string>('');
  const [serverVersionCode, setServerVersionCode] = useState<number>(0);
  const [currentInstalledCode, setCurrentInstalledCode] = useState<number>(CURRENT_BUILD_NUMBER);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isInstalling, setIsInstalling] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>('');
  const [isNative, setIsNative] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [hasCheckedOnce, setHasCheckedOnce] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsNative(Capacitor.isNativePlatform());
  }, []);

  // Lógica unificada de verificación (automática al inicio y manual mediante el botón)
  const verificarActualizaciones = useCallback(async (esManual: boolean = false) => {
    setLoading(true);
    if (esManual) setStatus('Comprobando actualizaciones en GitHub...');

    try {
      // 1. Obtener la versión de compilación nativa instalada en el dispositivo
      let versionActual = CURRENT_BUILD_NUMBER;
      try {
        versionActual = await getSafeAppVersionCode();
        setCurrentInstalledCode(versionActual);
      } catch {
        versionActual = CURRENT_BUILD_NUMBER;
      }

      // 2. Consultar el archivo version.json
      const repo = updateService.getGitHubRepo() || 'cuentadecuperacion7525-hub/Mi-B-veda.-';
      const cacheBuster = `_t=${Date.now()}`;
      // Comprobar tanto la rama 'principal' (rama por defecto en tu repo) como 'main'
      const urlGitHubPrincipal = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${repo}/principal/public/version.json?${cacheBuster}`;
      const urlGitHubMain = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${repo}/main/public/version.json?${cacheBuster}`;

      let datos: VersionResponseData | null = null;

      // Intentar primero desde GitHub público en la rama 'principal'
      try {
        let respuesta = await fetch(urlGitHubPrincipal, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (!respuesta.ok) {
          respuesta = await fetch(urlGitHubMain, { cache: 'no-store' });
        }
        if (respuesta.ok) {
          datos = await respuesta.json();
        }
      } catch (ghErr) {
        console.warn('[BovedaUpdater] No se pudo conectar directo a raw GitHub, probando origen local:', ghErr);
      }

      // Fallback a version.json del origen local
      if (!datos) {
        const respuestaLocal = await fetch(`/version.json?${cacheBuster}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (respuestaLocal.ok) {
          datos = await respuestaLocal.json();
        }
      }

      if (!datos) {
        throw new Error('No se pudo verificar con el servidor. Revisa tu conexión a internet.');
      }

      // Soportar tanto version_code/version_name como buildNumber/version
      const codigoRemoto = datos.version_code ?? datos.buildNumber ?? 0;
      const nombreRemoto = datos.version_name ?? datos.version ?? CURRENT_APP_VERSION;
      const urlDescarga = datos.download_url || `https://github.com/${repo}/releases/latest`;

      setServerVersionCode(codigoRemoto);
      setServerVersionName(nombreRemoto);
      setHasCheckedOnce(true);

      // Comprobar si hay versión superior
      if (codigoRemoto > versionActual) {
        setUpdateAvailable(true);
        setDownloadUrl(urlDescarga);
        setStatus(`¡Nueva versión v${nombreRemoto} disponible! Lista para instalar.`);
      } else {
        setUpdateAvailable(false);
        if (esManual) {
          setStatus(`Tu bóveda está en la versión más reciente (v${CURRENT_APP_VERSION}).`);
        }
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (esManual) {
        setStatus(error?.message || 'Error de conexión. Inténtalo más tarde.');
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // Comprobación inicial al montar
  useEffect(() => {
    verificarActualizaciones(false);
  }, [verificarActualizaciones]);

  // Ejecución de la descarga e instalación automática
  const ejecutarActualizacion = async () => {
    if (!downloadUrl) return;
    setIsInstalling(true);
    setStatus('Descargando e iniciando instalación de la actualización...');
    try {
      await downloadAndInstallApk(downloadUrl);
      setStatus('Proceso de instalación enviado al sistema Android.');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus(err.message || 'No se pudo completar la instalación automática.');
    } finally {
      setIsInstalling(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#0a121d] p-4.5 sm:p-5 rounded-3xl border border-cyan-500/30 shadow-xl space-y-4">
      {/* Encabezado: Estado de la versión y plataforma */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[#00e5ff] shrink-0 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/10">
            <RefreshCw className={`w-5 h-5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">Versión del Sistema</h4>
              <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#00e5ff] bg-cyan-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-cyan-500/25">
                v{CURRENT_APP_VERSION}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-medium truncate mt-0.5">
              Lanzamiento: {CURRENT_RELEASE_DATE}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Badge dinámico de estado */}
        {updateAvailable ? (
          <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 text-[#00e5ff] border border-cyan-500/40 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1">
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
            Nueva versión
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="shrink-0 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[2.5]" />
            Al día
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Indicador de capa y comparación de versiones */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-300 bg-slate-900/80 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 font-mono">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${isNative ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-cyan-400'}`} />
          <span className="text-slate-400">Plataforma:</span>
          <span className="text-white font-semibold">{isNative ? 'APK Android' : 'Web'}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-slate-400">
          Build <span className="text-slate-200 font-bold">{currentInstalledCode}</span>
          {serverVersionCode > 0 && (
            <span> / Servidor <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">{serverVersionCode}</span></span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mensaje de estado dinámico */}
      {status && (
        <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-medium border leading-relaxed ${
          updateAvailable
            ? 'bg-cyan-950/40 border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-200'
            : 'bg-slate-900/70 border-slate-800 text-slate-300'
        }`}>
          {status}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* EL BOTÓN PRINCIPAL ÚNICO (EL BUENO)                       */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
        {updateAvailable ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={ejecutarActualizacion}
            disabled={isInstalling}
            className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 via-teal-500 to-emerald-600 hover:from-emerald-400 hover:to-teal-400 active:scale-[0.99] text-white font-bold rounded-2xl text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Download className={`w-4 h-4 ${isInstalling ? 'animate-bounce' : ''}`} />
            <span>
              {isInstalling ? 'Instalando actualización...' : `Instalar Actualización v${serverVersionName || 'Nueva'}`}
            </span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => verificarActualizaciones(true)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 active:scale-[0.99] text-white font-bold rounded-2xl text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/25 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{loading ? 'Buscando actualizaciones...' : 'Buscar Actualizaciones'}</span>
          </button>
        )}

        {/* Botones secundarios complementarios */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {onOpenChangelog && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onOpenChangelog}
              className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white font-semibold text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00e5ff]" />
              <span>Novedades de esta Versión</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => window.open('https://github.com/cuentadecuperacion7525-hub/Mi-B-veda.-/actions', '_blank')}
            className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 hover:border-cyan-500/30 text-slate-400 hover:text-[#00e5ff] font-medium text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Descarga manual (GitHub)</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Información de seguridad y estado de instalación */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800/80 text-xs text-slate-300 space-y-1.5">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-slate-400">Estado de instalación:</span>
          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
            <Check className="w-3 h-3 stroke-[3]" />
            Optimizado sin pérdida de datos
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-slate-400">Comprobación:</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-slate-400">En tiempo real vía red</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


// >>>>>>>>>> FILE: src/components/CameraCaptureModal.tsx <<<<<<<<<<
import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Camera, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Check, Video, Circle, Square } from 'lucide-react';

interface CameraCaptureModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onMediaCaptured: (buffer: ArrayBuffer, mimeType: string, filename: string) => Promise<void>;
  showToast: (msg: string, type?: 'info' | 'success' | 'alert' | 'error') => void;
  initialMode?: 'photo' | 'video';
}

export const CameraCaptureModal: React.FC<CameraCaptureModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onMediaCaptured,
  showToast,
  initialMode = 'photo',
}) => {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const recordedChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'photo' | 'video'>('photo');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && initialMode) {
      setMode(initialMode);
    }
  }, [isOpen, initialMode]);
  const [stream, setStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [facingMode, setFacingMode] = useState<'user' | 'environment'>('environment');
  const [hasCameraError, setHasCameraError] = useState(false);

  // Photo capture preview
  const [capturedBlobUrl, setCapturedBlobUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tempBuffer, setTempBuffer] = useState<ArrayBuffer | null>(null);
  const [capturedMime, setCapturedMime] = useState<string>('image/jpeg');

  // Video recording state
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordingSeconds, setRecordingSeconds] = useState(0);
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      stopCamera();
      resetCaptures();
      return;
    }

    startCamera(facingMode);

    return () => {
      stopCamera();
    };
  }, [isOpen, facingMode]);

  const stopCamera = () => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state === 'recording') {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
    }
    if (stream) {
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      setStream(null);
    }
  };

  const resetCaptures = () => {
    if (capturedBlobUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(capturedBlobUrl);
    }
    setCapturedBlobUrl(null);
    setTempBuffer(null);
    setIsRecording(false);
    setRecordingSeconds(0);
  };

  const startCamera = async (fMode: 'user' | 'environment') => {
    stopCamera();
    setHasCameraError(false);

    try {
      const newStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: fMode,
          width: { ideal: 1920 },
          height: { ideal: 1080 },
        },
        audio: true, // For videos
      });

      setStream(newStream);
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = newStream;
      }
    } catch {
      // Try again without audio if audio permissions failed
      try {
        const videoOnlyStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: {
            facingMode: fMode,
            width: { ideal: 1920 },
            height: { ideal: 1080 },
          },
          audio: false,
        });
        setStream(videoOnlyStream);
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = videoOnlyStream;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Camera access denied:', err);
        setHasCameraError(true);
      }
    }
  };

  const switchCamera = () => {
    setFacingMode((prev) => (prev === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment'));
  };

  // PHOTO CAPTURE
  const capturePhoto = () => {
    if (!videoRef.current || !canvasRef.current) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;

    canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 1280;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 720;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    if (facingMode === 'user') {
      ctx.translate(canvas.width, 0);
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
    }

    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (!blob) return;
      blob.arrayBuffer().then((buffer) => {
        setTempBuffer(buffer);
        setCapturedMime('image/jpeg');
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setCapturedBlobUrl(url);
      });
    }, 'image/jpeg', 0.92);
  };

  // VIDEO RECORDING
  const startRecording = () => {
    if (!stream) return;
    recordedChunksRef.current = [];

    let mimeType = 'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus';
    if (!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType)) {
      mimeType = 'video/webm';
      if (!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType)) {
        mimeType = 'video/mp4';
      }
    }

    try {
      const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType) ? mimeType : undefined });
      mediaRecorderRef.current = recorder;

      recorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
        if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
          recordedChunksRef.current.push(event.data);
        }
      };

      recorder.onstop = async () => {
        const blob = new Blob(recordedChunksRef.current, { type: recorder.mimeType || 'video/webm' });
        const buffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
        setTempBuffer(buffer);
        setCapturedMime(recorder.mimeType || 'video/webm');
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setCapturedBlobUrl(url);
      };

      recorder.start(500); // 500ms chunk slices
      setIsRecording(true);
      setRecordingSeconds(0);

      timerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
        setRecordingSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error starting video recording:', err);
      showToast('No se pudo iniciar la grabación de video', 'error');
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (timerRef.current) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      timerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && mediaRecorderRef.current.state === 'recording') {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
    }
    setIsRecording(false);
  };

  const handleConfirmSave = async () => {
    if (!tempBuffer) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const isVideoType = mode === 'video' || capturedMime.startsWith('video');
      const ext = isVideoType ? 'mp4' : 'jpg';
      const filename = `${isVideoType ? 'video' : 'foto'}_camara_${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
      await onMediaCaptured(tempBuffer, capturedMime, filename);
      showToast(isVideoType ? 'Video cifrado y guardado con éxito' : 'Foto cifrada y guardada con éxito', 'success');
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error saving captured media:', err);
      showToast('Error al cifrar el archivo', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const formatTimer = (secs: number) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${mins}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/95 backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col justify-between p-4 select-none">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between z-10 px-2 py-1">
        {/* Mode switcher tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-1 text-xs">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (!isRecording) {
                setMode('photo');
                resetCaptures();
              }
            }}
            disabled={isRecording}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              mode === 'photo' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Foto</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (!isRecording) {
                setMode('video');
                resetCaptures();
              }
            }}
            disabled={isRecording}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              mode === 'video' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Video</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          disabled={isRecording}
          className="p-2 rounded-full bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 transition-colors"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Viewfinder Stage */}
      <div className="relative flex-1 flex items-center justify-center my-2 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800/80">
        <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

        {/* Captured Preview */}
        {capturedBlobUrl ? (
          mode === 'video' || capturedMime.startsWith('video') ? (
            <video
              src={capturedBlobUrl}
              controls
              autoPlay
              playsInline
              className="w-full h-full object-contain"
            />
          ) : (
            <img
              src={capturedBlobUrl}
              alt="Captura"
              className="w-full h-full object-contain"
            />
          )
        ) : hasCameraError ? (
          <div className="text-center p-6 max-w-xs text-slate-400 space-y-3">
            <AlertCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">Cámara no disponible</h4>
            <p className="text-xs">
              Verifica los permisos del navegador o selecciona archivos multimedia desde tu galería.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <video
            ref={videoRef}
            autoPlay
            playsInline
            muted
            className={`w-full h-full object-cover ${facingMode === 'user' ? '-scale-x-100' : ''}`}
          />
        )}

        {/* Video recording indicator */}
        {isRecording && (
          <div className="absolute top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-rose-600/90 text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg animate-pulse">
            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white animate-ping" />
            <span>REC {formatTimer(recordingSeconds)}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer controls */}
      <div className="py-4 flex items-center justify-around max-w-sm mx-auto w-full z-10">
        {capturedBlobUrl ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 w-full">
            <button
              onClick={resetCaptures}
              disabled={isSaving}
              className="flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold rounded-2xl transition-colors"
            >
              Repetir
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleConfirmSave}
              disabled={isSaving}
              className="flex-1 py-3 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-2xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{isSaving ? 'Cifrando...' : 'Guardar Cifrado'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={switchCamera}
              disabled={hasCameraError || isRecording}
              className="p-3.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 transition-colors disabled:opacity-30"
              title="Cambiar Cámara"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>

            {/* Shutter / Record Button */}
            {mode === 'photo' ? (
              <button
                onClick={capturePhoto}
                disabled={hasCameraError}
                className="w-18 h-18 rounded-full border-4 border-white/80 p-1 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 transition-transform disabled:opacity-30"
                title="Tomar Foto"
              >
                <div className="w-full h-full bg-white rounded-full hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors" />
              </button>
            ) : isRecording ? (
              <button
                onClick={stopRecording}
                className="w-18 h-18 rounded-full border-4 border-rose-500 p-1 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 transition-transform"
                title="Detener Grabación"
              >
                <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-rose-600 rounded-lg shadow-md shadow-rose-600/50" />
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={startRecording}
                disabled={hasCameraError}
                className="w-18 h-18 rounded-full border-4 border-rose-500/80 p-1 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 transition-transform disabled:opacity-30"
                title="Iniciar Grabación de Video"
              >
                <div className="w-full h-full bg-rose-600 rounded-full hover:bg-rose-500 transition-colors" />
              </button>
            )}

            <div className="w-12" />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Folder, FolderPlus, X, Check, ArrowRight, Trash2, Edit2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface CreateFolderModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  category: 'photo' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'app';
  existingFolders: string[];
  onCreate: (folderName: string) => void;
}

export function CreateFolderModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  category,
  existingFolders,
  onCreate,
}: CreateFolderModalProps) {
  const [folderName, setFolderName] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const categoryLabel =
    category === 'photo'
      ? 'Imágenes'
      : category === 'video'
      ? 'Videos'
      : category === 'audio'
      ? 'Audio'
      : 'Archivos';

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = folderName.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setError('El nombre de la carpeta no puede estar vacío');
      return;
    }
    if (existingFolders.some((f) => f.toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase())) {
      setError('Ya existe una carpeta con este nombre');
      return;
    }

    onCreate(trimmed);
    setFolderName('');
    setError('');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 select-none">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400">
              <FolderPlus className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-100">Nueva Carpeta</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">En la sección {categoryLabel}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-300 mb-1.5">
              Nombre de la carpeta
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              autoFocus
              value={folderName}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFolderName(e.target.value);
                setError('');
              }}
              placeholder="Ej: Personal, Viajes, Trabajo..."
              maxLength={40}
              className="w-full bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-850 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-700 transition-colors"
            />
            {error && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-400 mt-1">{error}</p>}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancelar
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={!folderName.trim()}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-white disabled:opacity-40 text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.5]" />
              <span>Crear</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface RenameFolderModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  category: 'photo' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'app';
  currentFolderName: string;
  existingFolders: string[];
  onRename: (oldName: string, newName: string) => void;
}

export function RenameFolderModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  category,
  currentFolderName,
  existingFolders,
  onRename,
}: RenameFolderModalProps) {
  const [folderName, setFolderName] = useState(currentFolderName);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    setFolderName(currentFolderName);
    setError('');
  }, [currentFolderName, isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const categoryLabel =
    category === 'photo'
      ? 'Imágenes'
      : category === 'video'
      ? 'Videos'
      : category === 'audio'
      ? 'Audio'
      : 'Archivos';

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = folderName.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setError('El nombre no puede estar vacío');
      return;
    }
    if (
      trimmed.toLowerCase() !== currentFolderName.toLowerCase() &&
      existingFolders.some((f) => f.toLowerCase() === trimmed.toLowerCase())
    ) {
      setError('Ya existe otra carpeta con este nombre');
      return;
    }

    onRename(currentFolderName, trimmed);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 select-none">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400">
              <Edit2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-100">Renombrar Carpeta</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">En la sección {categoryLabel}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-300 mb-1.5">
              Nuevo nombre
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              autoFocus
              value={folderName}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFolderName(e.target.value);
                setError('');
              }}
              maxLength={40}
              className="w-full bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-850 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-700 transition-colors"
            />
            {error && <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-400 mt-1">{error}</p>}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancelar
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={!folderName.trim() || folderName.trim() === currentFolderName}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-white disabled:opacity-40 text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.5]" />
              <span>Guardar</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface MoveToFolderModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedCount: number;
  category: 'photo' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'app';
  currentFolder?: string | null;
  folders: string[];
  onMove: (targetFolder: string) => void;
  onOpenCreateFolder: () => void;
}

export function MoveToFolderModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedCount,
  category,
  currentFolder,
  folders,
  onMove,
  onOpenCreateFolder,
}: MoveToFolderModalProps) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const categoryLabel =
    category === 'photo'
      ? 'imágenes'
      : category === 'video'
      ? 'videos'
      : category === 'audio'
      ? 'audios'
      : 'archivos';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 select-none">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

              <Folder className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-100">Mover a Carpeta</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                {selectedCount} {categoryLabel} seleccionada(s)
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Folder List */}
        <div className="max-h-60 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1 no-scrollbar">

                  onClose();

                  isCurrent
                    ? 'bg-zinc-800 border-zinc-700 text-zinc-100 font-semibold'

                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 truncate">
                  <Folder className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${isCurrent ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-500'}`} />
                  <span className="text-xs truncate">{folder}</span>
                </div>
                {isCurrent ? (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-mono bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-500/20 shrink-0">
                    Actual
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-600 shrink-0" />
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Action to create new folder directly */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              onClose();
              onOpenCreateFolder();
            }}
